Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's it from the first ODI. England have stamped their authority in this series and the Dutch now have a lot of thinking to do before their next game. This game is the one for the record books. The second ODI will be played on Sunday, 19th June. That game is all set to begin at 2:30 pm IST (9:00 am GMT). But as you all know, our build-up will begin in advance. So, do join us then! Till then, goodbye and take care!

Eoin Morgan the captain of England says it is great to be back and having the majority of the senior guys has helped. Adds it is good to see Salt and Malan play like they did and watching Buttler is incredible and it is amazing. States it is great to see the hunger in the players and nobody takes anything for granted. Ends by saying they do not take days like this for granted, they have worked very hard and are very happy with how they played

Pieter Seelaar the skipper of Netherlands jokes that saying getting Roy out was good. Further admits the drop catches did not help, they let themselves down but if they would have taken the wickets, they could have stopped them to a respectable score. Adds they'll learn from this and it will make them better and the experience will help. He hopes to put up a better performance in the next game. Ends by saying this is hard to take now but a couple of months later they'll accept it and if it makes them a better player, they'll take it and their batting was good.

Jos Buttler is the Player of the Match says he feels great, the Indian T20 League could not have gone better and that gave him a lot of confidence and he felt really good while batting and the platform laid gave them the license to attack. Adds he enjoyed the two months where he did not play cricket after the Ashes and the Indian T20 League was also good. Mentions they have a clear-cut style of playing and this trip is a great opportunity for the guys and it is exciting times for them. Informs he is trying to work on his six-hitting, staying back, and hitting down the ground.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, England were asked to bat first and they put on an outrageous show! They lost Jason Roy in the second over itself but since then they were all over Netherlands. Philip Salt, Jos Buttler, and Dawid Malan all brought up their centuries. Jos Buttler went on to score an unbeaten 162 off 70 balls. He hit 14 sixes and 7 fours in his knock and scored at a strike rate of over 230! Liam Livingstone scored a blistering knock of 66 off 22 balls and guided England to a total of 498 which is now the highest ODI total. They smashed 26 sixes and 36 fours in their innings Philippe Boissevain was Netherlands' most expensive bowler. He went for 108 runs in his spell of 10 overs and narrowly missed the record for leaking the most number of runs in ODI cricket. In reply, 5 of the Netherlands batters got off to a start but none of them went on to make it big, and in the end, Scott Edwards was left alone along with the tail-enders. Netherlands did well to reach to a score of 266, which is not a bad total at all, but just that in front of the mountain, it looks like a mole.

The hosts have put on a dominant show here! After an exuberant batting display, they put in a collective bowling performance. All their bowlers except Adil Rashid grabbed a wicket. Moeen Ali was the leader of the pack as he took 3 wickets, while all the seamers grabbed two wickets each. England were never under pressure during the chase. They took an early wicket, broke all the crucial partnerships at the right time, and then clinched this game with ease. The only thing that did not go their way was the toss.

Tough day for Netherlands! They will be mighty disappointed with their performance. Coming into bat, they did lose Vikramjit Singh early on, but Max O'Dowd and Musa Ahmad scored runs freely, they showed some aggression. The duo put together 80 runs before Musa Ahmad perished. Max O'Dowd notched up his half-ton and departed soon after that. Post his wicket, there was no intent shown from the Dutch batters. They kept their wickets intact, but runs were not flowing for them. As a result, the required run-rate kept increasing. Towards the end, they lost wickets in a heap. Scott Edwards did toil hard in the middle. He scored an unbeaten 72 but in the end, there were far too many runs to chase.

An empathic win for England at the end! They have clinched this game and have taken a 1-0 lead in this series. It was always going to be a daunting task for Netherlands to chase a target of close to 500. But it's been a day that to forget for the hosts. England have also grabbed 10 vital ICC Super League points after this historic win!

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is the end of the game! A huge win for England as they emerge victorious by 232 runs. Shorter and outside off, Philippe Boissevain looks to cut but gets an outside edge to the keeper.

Full again, around off. Musa Ahmad sweeps it toward deep square leg for a brace. Two taken!
Loopy ball full, from 'round the wicket, around off. Musa Ahmad presses forward and defends it out.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over!
On a length, on middle. Max O'Dowd defends it out.
FOUR! Another lovely shot! A pitched up delivery, around middle. Max O'Dowd lifts it straight down the ground for a boundary. Consecutive fours for Max O'Dowd!
FOUR! Nicely done! A shorter ball, down the leg side. Max O'Dowd pulls it over the fielder at short fine leg for a boundary.
On a good length, around middle. Max O'Dowd blocks it out from within his crease.
A length delivery, around middle and off. Max O'Dowd blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Musa Ahmad pulls it through square leg for a single.
A length delivery, around off. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards cover. Good over for Netherlands, 9 runs off it!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! David Willey changes his length, serves a half-volley, around off. Max O'Dowd shows the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Outside off, short in length. Max O'Dowd stays back, swivels, and pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Too short now, down the leg side. Max O'Dowd looks to pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Touch short, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd looks to flick again and misses it.
Darting it on the pads, length ball. Max O'Dowd misses his flick and gets rapped on his pads.
Angling in on a length, around middle. Max O'Dowd defends it out.
Length, outside off. Musa Ahmad defends it out. Good first over from Sam Curran! Just 1 run off it
Back of a length, outside off. Musa Ahmad once again defends it towards cover.
On a length, around the off pole. Musa Ahmad pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Outside off, short in length. Musa Ahmad ducks underneath it.
Full in length, around the off pole. Musa Ahmad blocks it out.
Sam Curran begins with a shortish ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd hangs back and cuts it towards third man. One run taken!
Sam Curran comes into the attack.
Length delivery, on the pads. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards short fine leg and scampers across to the other end for a quick single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Darting it on the pads, on a length. Max O'Dowd misses his flick and the ball deflects off his pads and goes towards fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd presses forward and dabs it towards cover.
Outside off, shorter in length. Musa Ahmad cuts it past point for a single.
Shortish ball, outside off. Musa Ahmad leaves it alone.
Angling in on a length, darting it on the pads. Max O'Dowd tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
A low full toss, around middle. Musa Ahmad drives it straight onto the stumps at the non-striker's end.
An overpitched delivery, outside off. Musa Ahmad pushes it towards cover.
Fuller, around off. Musa Ahmad defends it out.

EDGY FOUR! A fuller ball, outside off. Musa Ahmad presses forward and tries to drive this away from his body, but the ball goes off the outside just away from Dawid Malan at second slip and towards third man for a boundary.
Angling in on the pads, length delivery. Musa Ahmad tucks it towards square leg.
On a length, around middle. Musa Ahmad shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out watchfully.
Outside off, tad shorter. Musa Ahmad slashes it towards deep point for a single. He retains the strike!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Musa Ahmad defends it back to the bowler.
Pitches this one up, outside off. Musa Ahmad drives and finds the fielder at extra cover.
A length delivery, darting it on the pads. Musa Ahmad flicks it towards fine leg for a brace.
Lovely ball! A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Musa Ahmad hangs back and looks to push this away on the off side, but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd leans to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd flicks it past mid-wicket. Liam Livingstone chases the ball, slides and makes a good stop. Three taken!
Outside off, tad shorter. Musa Ahmad dabs it towards third man for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Musa Ahmad drives towards cover. Liam Livingstone dives and makes an excellent stop there!
Yorker-length delivery, wide of off. Max O'Dowd squeezes it out towards cover for a single.
Shorter and width on offer. Max O'Dowd cuts and finds the fielder at point.
Wide! Down the leg side. Max O'Dowd misses his flick. Wide called!
Pitched up delivery, around off. Max O'Dowd pushes it towards cover.
On a length, around middle. Musa Ahmad blocks it out.
Musa Ahmad is the new man in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! David Willey draws first blood! Netherlands have lost one of their best batters, Vikramjit Singh! A length ball, this one nips back in around middle. Vikramjit Singh looks to block this but the misses. The ball goes in the gap between bat and pad and knocks the stumps over.
Back of a length, around off. Vikramjit Singh dabs it towards point.
Angling in on a fuller length, around middle. Vikramjit Singh works it away to the fielder at mid on.
A length ball now, shaping away, outside off. Vikramjit Singh drives it firmly once again through cover. Two taken!
Full in length, around the off pole. Vikramjit Singh blocks it out towards the off side.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Vikramjit Singh drives it past point for a single.
An overpitched delivery, around off. Vikramjit Singh drives it gently through cover for a brace.
Swing and a miss! Length ball, swinging away, outside off. Vikramjit Singh looks to push this away but he misses.
On a length, around middle and leg, at 131 clicks. Vikramjit Singh tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Shaping away, outside off, a length delivery. Vikramjit Singh leaves it alone.
FOUR! Vikramjit Singh greets Reece Topley with a boundary! Short and wide of off. Vikramjit Singh slashes this past point for a boundary. First boundary of the innings!
Reece Topley will bowl from the other end!
A length delivery, on the pads. Vikramjit Singh tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.

Leg bye! A stifled appeal for LBW, but turned down! On a length, angling in, around the leg pole. Max O'Dowd looks to tuck this away but he misses and gets hit on his pads. It rolls towards fine leg and the batters take a leg bye!
Pitches it up, around off. Max O'Dowd drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Wide! Wide of off, fuller ball. Max O'Dowd leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, outside off. Max O'Dowd leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, hint of away movement there, outside off. Vikramjit Singh punches this off the back foot past extra cover. Three taken! Netherlands and Vikramjit Singh are underway!
David Willey begins with a length ball, angling in, on the pads. Vikramjit Singh tucks it towards square leg.
